jurisdiction.venue: Directorate of Enforcement (ED), Chennai Zonal Office-II (PMLA, 2002)

docket_number: ED Chennai Zonal Office-II PMLA PAO (Nov. 26, 2026)
headline: India’s E.D. Attaches ₹12.64 Crore Karaikal Hotel Linked to Alleged France Gold-Smuggling and Crypto Hawala Trail
deck: Acting on a referral from the French government, Chennai investigators provisionally attached the five-story Hotel Le Royale Palace in Puducherry after alleging commission-based smuggling proceeds were wired via the U.A.E. into an Indian N.R.E. account.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: India’s Enforcement Directorate provisionally attached the land and five-story building of Hotel Le Royale Palace in Karaikal, Puducherry (valued at ₹12.64 crore) following information from France alleging gold smuggling, hawala, and illegal crypto transfers from 2019 to 2023 funded the hotel’s construction through UAE wires and cash deposits.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Running an off-the-books gold-and-crypto courier desk in Paris, bouncing the commissions through Dubai cash agents, and bricking the balance into a five-story coastal hotel
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Multi-year imprisonment and asset confiscation under India’s Prevention of Money Laundering Act upon adjudication; all allegations remain under investigation

sources.title: Press Release: ED Chennai Zonal Office-II Provisionally Attaches Hotel Le Royale Palace, Karaikal Valued at Approx. Rs. 12.64 Crore Under PMLA, 2002

interactive_art_spec.caption: The Madras High Court in Chennai, whose jurisdiction spans Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. The Enforcement Directorate’s Chennai Zonal Office-II provisionally attached the five-story Hotel Le Royale Palace in Karaikal following a French government referral.
